purpose.domain_detail: Credit card account management - account update screen processing for a CICS online application (AWS CardDemo reference app)
purpose.summary: COACTUPC is a CICS online program that accepts and processes credit card account update transactions. It validates user input fields including account status, credit limits, balances, dates (open date, expiry, reissue), customer SSN, phone numbers, and FICO scores, then updates account records. It is part of the AWS CardDemo mainframe modernization reference application.

notable_features: 88-level condition names extensively used for field validation
REDEFINES clauses for numeric/character dual access
SSN validation logic with invalid range checks
Multiple date field validations (open date, expiry, reissue, date of birth)
Apache License 2.0 header - AWS open source reference app
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars but sufficient evidence is present. This is the AWS CardDemo open-source COBOL modernization reference application published by Amazon. The program is a realistic, production-quality CICS online program for credit card account updates.
